property_summary: For every admissible input, C.transfer never successfully returns false — it either reverts when _tos.length==0 or returns true after successful calls; the mutant violates this by returning false (not reverting) when _tos.length==0.
change_summary: Change the function to return false immediately when _tos.length == 0 instead of reverting, altering return behavior for empty _tos.
